name: skyline_lock

name: yaw_sweep
caption: the DEM ridge (magenta) swept through every yaw over the photograph; the yellow meter is the fit and it peaks where the ridge locks onto the extracted skyline (cyan), at yaw 149.9

name: yaw_profile
caption: the op returns the whole residual curve so that the ambiguity is visible: a runner-up valley at 15 deg is 1.28 deg worse; the flat DEM curve is level

name: sun_track

name: numbers
